seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Late July to late August, when the approach has melted out but the glacier snow bridges are still intact

June.reason: The long approach is still under deep snow, the creek crossings run high, and the granite faces are wet and icy near the base.

July.reason: The approach snow is melting and the glacier is well bridged, but early in the month the west face and moat at its base are often wet.

August.reason: The rock is dry and daylight is long for the multi-day approach; glacier snow bridges thin and can fail by the end of the month.

September.reason: Snow bridges have melted, exposing open crevasses and a wide bergschrund, and shorter days stretch an already long approach.

October.reason: Early snowstorms can bury the granite and close off the long off-trail approach, leaving no easy way out.

evidence: Abegg, North Gunsight WF Aug 1-5 2018 via Downey/Bachelor Creek; Chickamin Glacier snow bridge melted out a couple of weeks later https://stephabegg.com/trip-reports/washington/north-gunsight-wf/
